issuer: the Instituto de Movilidad del Estado de Quintana Roo (IMOVEQROO)
note: Read 2026-10-30 in the Orden Jurídico Nacional (SEGOB), the federal government's compilation of state laws (ordenjuridico.gob.mx; the state's own hosts, the Congress's and the Periódico Oficial's reset or answered Cloudflare's challenge in wave 12 and weren't tried again). The Ley de Movilidad del Estado de Quintana Roo (Decreto 213, P.O. 14 June 2018; the copy carries reforms to P.O. 28 April 2023), Word file converted to text (mx23-ley.txt). Art. 216 (reformed 2023): the Instituto (IMOVEQROO, art. 3 XXXVI) issues driving licences of every kind. Art. 3 LIII and art. 172: a 'permiso para conducir' is what the Instituto issues to someone over fifteen and under eighteen; the age of the licence is read from that, 18 (a reading, as wave 12 read Guanajuato's and Yucatán's: the law states no age for the licence itself). The term isn't one number: the Ley de Derechos del Estado de Quintana Roo (Decreto 292, P.O. 31 December 2018; the copy carries reforms to P.O. 23 December 2022, mx23-derechos.txt), art. 75 I, charges the issue, renewal or replacement of a licence 'cada' two, three, four or five years, the automovilista's at 5.18, 7.77, 10.36 or 12.95 UMA, so the years stand null and so does the fee (the form holds one term and one fee, not a choice of them; the fee is also under the Secretaría de Seguridad Pública's heading, the 2022 text predating the 2023 reform that gave the licence to the Instituto). Whether a later Ley de Derechos (2023 to 2026) changed the terms wasn't read. The 1991 Reglamento de Tránsito (reformed to 2011, mx23-regl.txt) gave a two-year licence from 18, or from 16 with a guardian's authorisation, issued by the Dirección de Tránsito: it predates the 2018 law and isn't held. Held, as every other state's is, at its shortest term with that term's charge: two years at 5.18 UMA, worth the UMA's value on the day paid (the lead, 2026-10-30, when the form took a fee in an index unit; the longer terms are in the note).

sources.title: Ley de Movilidad del Estado de Quintana Roo (Orden Jurídico Nacional copy, last reform P.O. 28 April 2023)
sources.said: ÚLTIMA REFORMA PUBLICADA EN EL PERIÓDICO OFICIAL: 28 DE ABRIL DE 2023. ... XXXVI. Instituto: Instituto de Movilidad del Estado de Quintana Roo; ... LIII. Permiso para conducir: Documento que expide el Instituto a una persona mayor de quince y menor de dieciocho años de edad y que lo autoriza para conducir un vehículo motorizado ... El Instituto podrá otorgar permisos para conducir vehículos motorizados de uso particular a personas físicas menores de dieciocho y mayores de quince años de edad ... Artículo 216. El Instituto expedirá las licencias de conducir en todas sus modalidades

Licencia de automovilista 5.18 ... d) Cinco años ... 2. Licencia de automovilista 12.95
